segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: In the last days, a mountain would rise above all mountains — not by height, but by drawing every people to it.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: That is Isaiah writing, not God speaking — a prophet describing what he was shown. In the last days, he says, the house of the Lord will be set up higher than anything else on earth, and people from every nation will come streaming toward it.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths:

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Nations streaming uphill — not summoned by force, but drawn by invitation. The mountain everyone chooses to climb.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And from that high place, God's teaching would go out

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The mountain is open to you. Come, and walk in his paths.
